mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5% are not significantly higher than the baseline (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) rises above 8.5% for two consecutive months, it signals an impending recession that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as investors anticipate central bank intervention.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods when UNRATE > 8.5 for two consecutive months are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and residential fixed investment (RSAFS) signals a deepening demand contraction that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods when HOUST < 600 and RSAFS < 340000 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 90 (index 2017=100) for two consecutive months, it signals a severe supply shock that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when INDPRO < 90 for two consecutive months are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in housing starts (HOUST) signals a weakening housing market that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the market anticipates central bank intervention.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when HOUST is below its 12-month moving average are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) below 210 (index 1982-1984=100) for two consecutive months signals a deflationary risk that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as the market anticipates central bank intervention to prevent deflation.
failure_condition: The 5-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL < 210 for two consecutive months are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% and an unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 8.5% signals a deepening recession that triggers a flight to quality and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in a policy response.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.5 and UNRATE > 8.5 are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL rising above 220 for two consecutive months), the market prices in a policy response that drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the central bank tightens policy to combat inflation, which is perceived as a sign of economic strength.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods when CPIAUCSL > 220 for two consecutive months are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
